drums.description: Hard rock drum track featuring a high-gain, punchy acoustic kit, The performance is centered around a heavy backbeat with a crisp, metallic snare and a resonant, deep kick drum, The hi-hats are played slightly open for a washier texture during driving sections and tightly closed for syncopated grooves, Frequent use of crash cymbals accentuates transitions and downbeats, The kick drum follows a syncopated pattern with occasional double-stroke flourishes, The snare features consistent rimshots for a sharp attack, The recording has a natural room reverb, providing a sense of space without washing out the transients, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time Publish

bass.description: Alternative rock with a heavy grunge influence, The track features a prominent, overdriven electric bass guitar playing a repetitive eighth-note riff, Distorted electric guitars enter with thick power chords and a melodic lead line using a wah-wah pedal effect, The drum kit uses a standard rock beat with heavy compression on the snare and frequent open hi-hat accents, The tempo is 115 BPM in 4/4 time signature, The arrangement builds through layers of guitar feedback and sustained power chords Publish
